meta.name: general-video
meta.description: Author or edit a custom HyperFrames composition when no specialized workflow fits, or when BRIEF.md sets flow: companion. Use for longer or multi-scene pieces, brand and sizzle reels, montages, static loops, static title cards, footage remixes, and freeform builds. Use motion-graphics instead for a short unnarrated motion-first unit, including an animated title. Route fresh creation through hyperframes before using this skill.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 按需编排镜头与动态元素,产出多场景视频、品牌宣传片或混剪成片
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果要做较长的多场景视频或宣传片,却没有现成的专用流程可用
copy.tagline_en: Compose scenes and motion to produce multi-scene videos, brand reels, or remixes
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need a longer multi-scene video but no specialized workflow fits

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 会用 HyperFrames 编排或剪辑自定义视频合成，覆盖多场景长片、品牌与宣传片、蒙太奇、静态循环、静态标题卡、素材重剪等；通常先出方案与 STORYBOARD.md，再进入搭建和渲染。
howto.when: 当没有更专门的工作流可套用，或 BRIEF.md 里 flow 设为 companion 时接管；短片、无旁白的动效单元改用 motion-graphics，全新创作先经 hyperframes 路由。

say.text: 帮我做一支品牌宣传短片，先给我完整方案
say.note: 先出故事线、设计规格和逐场景方案，供你删减

say.text: 把这批素材重剪成多场景蒙太奇
say.note: 按场景切分素材并重新排布时序

say.text: 做一张静态标题卡，循环播放
say.note: 搭建静态循环合成并渲染

howto.what_en: Claude authors or edits custom HyperFrames compositions: multi-scene pieces, brand and sizzle reels, montages, static loops, static title cards, footage remixes. It typically drafts a plan and STORYBOARD.md before building and rendering.
howto.when_en: Takes over when no specialized workflow fits, or when BRIEF.md sets flow: companion. Use motion-graphics for short unnarrated motion-first units; route fresh creation through hyperframes first.

say_en.text: Make a brand sizzle reel, show me the full plan first
say_en.note: Plan, design spec and per-scene treatment come first

say_en.text: Recut this footage into a multi-scene montage
say_en.note: Splits sources into scenes and reorders timing

say_en.text: Make a static title card that loops
say_en.note: Builds and renders the static loop composition
